scope: Corollary 7.3 (Asymptotically optimal SK optimization) of the manuscript “Full support of the zero-temperature Sherrington-Kirkpatrick order parameter” (preprints/Full-support-of-the-zero-temperature-Sherrington-Kirkpatrick-order-parameter-September-27-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 281 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 86256ac3e995c880), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 25. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every fixed ϵ > 0, there is a randomized algorithm with operation count at most C(ϵ)n2 in the model just described, where C(ϵ) is independent of n, that takes the Gaussian couplings of Hn as input and returns σalg ∈ {−1, 1}n such that Pr {︄ Hn(σalg ) ≥ max σ∈{−1,1}n Hn(σ) − ϵn }︄ −→ 1 (n → ∞). The probability includes the couplings and the algorithm’s randomness.
